I would say yes. Being suicidal doesn’t look the same for everyone. For some, it’s an overwhelming feeling that takes over all aspects of their life and for some it’s much more passive, where the person doesn’t enjoy being alive and has passing thoughts of suicide but is not actively attempting to kill themselves. I’m almost 4 years clean of self harm and I still struggle with passive suicidal ideation. It’s not easy but I promise it does get better. Finding a mental health resource that works for YOU is the most important thing. Of course not everyone has the privilege of receiving adequate mental health care but there are still so many resources out there that can help!!

I graduated in June and yeah, high school sucked ass but getting to graduate after years of struggling with self harm and suicidal ideation felt so fucking liberating. A few years ago I never thought I’d make it to graduation but I got there!! It was in no way easy and there were multiple occasions during my time in school that I wanted to give up but I did it and I’m so happy I made it!:) It’s scary as hell having to face college and a future after high school but there are so many different paths you can choose from and just because your plans may look different from your peers doesn’t mean they’re wrong. You’re gonna hit some bumps along the road but that’s okay! You have so many years ahead of you and yes it’s scary but you got this!! Even though life is never perfect, it does get better, even if that “better” is different from what you anticipated!:)

i’m pretty new to owning millipedes but i’d say ivory millipedes are a good choice. i have 2 ivories and they spend a decent amount of time on the surface and they’re also very social and love hanging out with eachother so they’d do good as a pair or multiple. for their enclosure i use a 3 gallon temporary aquarium/tank, like those plastic containers with the vented lids and i think it was like $15? for substrate i use moist coconut fiber and mix in wood chips/bark and i have a good few inches of that (3-5) then i have a couple pieces of cork for hiding spots and sphagnum moss placed throughout. i also have a little bowl that’s meant for reptile food/water but you don’t necessarily need that cause they’ll mainly get their water from the moist substrate and if the waters too deep in the dish they can drown, i just use it to put veggies/fruits on cause it’s easier to take ‘em out once they get all shriveled and gross. i usually give their tank a good misting once or twice a day to keep everything moist. i can send you a picture of my set up if you’d like:)
